content.dataset: all 948 released 3Sources term-frequency columns, ordered BBC/Guardian/Reuters and native column order
content.vocabulary: union of exact stripped released stem strings; align each view by term identity, not row number
content.preprocessing: released Porter stemming, stopword and term-frequency filtering retained; no invented raw text
content.normalization: L2 per document; zero vectors are isolated singletons
content.similarity: dot product of normalized pooled TF-IDF features, all record pairs
content.partition: undirected connected components of edges with cosine >= threshold; diagonal excluded
content.law: uniform group then uniform record in group, 1/(K*m)
content.center: minimize maximum full-record TV over convex mixtures of the declared candidate laws; pi in simplex; no free-center mass optimization
content.secondary_center: uniform candidate mixture; report as secondary, never choose using reference results
content.construction_freeze: partitions, candidate laws, centers and checksums saved before evaluation reads .docs or .clist
content.reference: uniform provided story ID then uniform record for that ID; provided linkage is not universal semantic ground truth
metrics: K, largest group, supplied-linkage pair precision/recall
all six topic errors, exact candidate topic ranges, health illustration
content.outcome_policy: retain both thresholds and all outcomes; no threshold search or reference-based selection; coverage may improve or remain poor

matched_H.paired_bootstrap: same resampled test-cluster counts applied jointly to both models and both laws; recompute every ratio denominator
matched_H.clusters: CC title+day; BBC union(title,content) test groups
matched_H.interval: unadjusted conditional percentile 95%, models/partitions/splits fixed; descriptive for nonsmooth absolute contrast
matched_H.selection: post-hoc review-driven diagnostic, not a preregistered confirmatory test; no cross-corpus reversal significance claim
